info.name: Matomo Reporting API for plugin Custom Alerts API
info.description: Exposes Custom Alerts API endpoints for managing alert definitions and reading triggered alert data. These methods let callers create, update, fetch, delete, and evaluate alerts for one or more sites.

item.name: Custom alerts get values for alert in past

query.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
(Required) Alert ID to evaluate.
(Required) Number of periods in the past to evaluate. Use 0 for the current day, week, or month.

(Required) Alert name.
(Required) Website ID(s) to query. Accepts comma-separated IDs, "all", numeric IDs as strings, or ["all"].
(Required) Alert period. Allowed values: day, week, month.
(Required) Whether to notify the current user by email when the alert triggers.
(Required) Additional email recipients for email notifications.
(Required) Additional email recipients for email notifications.
(Required) Mobile Messaging recipients when the mobile channel is enabled.
(Required) Mobile Messaging recipients when the mobile channel is enabled.
(Required) Metric unique ID to evaluate, for example nb_uniq_visits or sum_visit_length.
(Required) Comparison rule to apply to the metric. Allowed values: less_than, greater_than, decrease_more_than, increase_more_than, percentage_decrease_more_than, percentage_increase_more_than.
(Required) Threshold value to compare the selected metric against.
(Required) Number of prior periods to compare against. Allowed values by period: day => 1, 7, 365; week => 1; month => 1, 12.
(Required) Report unique ID in module_action format.

Optional dimension filter condition for report rows. Allowed values: matches_any, matches_exactly, does_not_match_exactly, matches_regex, does_not_match_regex, contains, does_not_contain, starts_with, does_not_start_with, ends_with, does_not_end_with.
Value to match when $reportCondition is provided.
Slack channel ID when the slack channel is enabled.
Microsoft Teams webhook URL when the teams channel is enabled.
Optional alert description (max 255 characters).
